queries.a: MATCH (u:ProbeRoot) RETURN u.uid AS uid, COUNT { MATCH (x:ProbeLeaf) WHERE x.key=u.key AND x.mark=true } AS value
queries.b: MATCH (u:ProbeRoot) OPTIONAL MATCH (x:ProbeLeaf) WHERE x.key=u.key AND x.mark=true WITH u,count(x) AS value RETURN u.uid AS uid,value

recipe.equivalence: COUNT of matched x equals OPTIONAL MATCH plus count(x), which ignores the NULL fallback. WITH groups by node u before projecting uid, preserving distinct roots even if their uid properties coincide. All roots have key=1 and one matching leaf.
recipe.work_obligation: Avoid re-scanning the same leaf table for each root with the same correlation key; compare scalar SubPlan loops with one filtered leaf scan and a LEFT join/aggregation.
recipe.novelty: Unverified native scalar-subquery decorrelation probe; do not label a missed optimization without actual work and ordinary-runtime evidence.
